summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K disclosing a weekly update on its share buyback program announced on 30 October 2025. Under the program, an independent intermediary is mandated to repurchase shares up to EUR 30 million. During 20-24 April 2026, the company repurchased 25,004 Nasdaq-listed shares at an average price of EUR 4.56 per share (total EUR 114,106). Since program start on 26 January 2026, 601,587 shares (1% of outstanding) have been bought back for EUR 2.71 million (USD 3.19 million). This is an open-market repurchase with no cross or block trades. Watch for continued execution pace and potential price support.
